run_singlepoint_calculations: run single point energy and force calculations on atomic structures using an ASE calculator
calculate_energy_for_atoms: calculate energy for a subset of atomic structures by splitting input data into parallel job chunks
write_results_to_json: write single point calculation results as a compressed JSON file to the specified results directory
normalize_properties_by_natoms: normalize calculated properties by number of atoms or a custom key in the atoms info dictionary
save_target_properties: save target properties from atoms info alongside calculated energy and force results in the output
